entry_sequence.action: for the first step we are looking for what's called a liquidity grab a liquidity grab is simply when price breaks a support or resistance and does a fake out and heads in the opposite direction
it can be either sell-side liquidity or buy side liquidity whichever you prefer to trade
the entry is pretty simple you were going to mark your entry point at the candle that made the liquidity grab
your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab
it's the same thing with shorts ... your short entry would be at the bottom of this candle that initiated this liquidity grab

confluences.description: Peaks closer together than 10 days saw a slightly larger drop compared to Peaks farther apart so if the liquidity grab and the entry candle were closer than 10 candles apart the drop was a lot larger compared to the Peaks further apart ... so if you want optimal entries you should look for liquidity grabs with Peaks closer together

another way to improve this is by adding confluences like divergences to do this simply go to metatrader click insert then indicators scroll down to oscillate and click momentum ... here the chart did a liquidity grab so it's making lower lows but if we look at the momentum oscillator it's making higher highs so this is a Divergence and is also a very bullish signal so we combine both the powers of the Divergence and the bullish liquidity grab and it gives us a higher probability of working in our favor

we then move to a 1hour time frame and we see this Buy Signal happened exactly at a support on a higher time frame so we know there's a strong demand here on the higher time frame and on top of that we have a liquidity grab on a lower time frame which is a great Confluence ... this whole liquidity grab strategy works best if you're finding reversals at the bottoms or tops of big moves

targets.description: set your take profit at a recent high (for shorts: setad her take profit at a recent low)

stop.anchor: you would enter here set your stop loss right right below the liquidity grab (for shorts: set our stop loss right above the liquidity grab)
